procedural_matters: AUS 77 was represented by Archie GARGETT
ITA 46 was represented by Federico FIGILIA DI GRANARA
Gabriel BRUNI (Coach to ITA 46) was an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was constituted in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: AUS 77 was sailing upwind close-hauled on starboard tack.
ITA 46 was sailing upwind close-hauled on port tack.
FRA 51 was sailing upwind close-hauled on starboard tack, approximately 1-2 boat lengths ahead and 1-2 boats lengths to leeward of AUS 77.
The boats were sailing at around 6 knots of boat speed.
ITA 46 bore away behind FRA 51 and ducked behind her.
ITA 46 then luffed and sailed to cross in front of AUS 77.
When ITA 46 was 0.5 metres from AUS 77's windward bow, AUS 77 bore away to avoid contact with ITA 46.
conclusions: There was a genuine and reasonable apprehension of a collision from AUS 7 and so ITA 46 on port failed to keep clear of AUS 77 on starboard, and broke RRS 10.
